title: A prospective study for validating an automated AI-based system for detecting age-related macular degeneration in clinical settings.
summary: The primary article reports prospective clinical validation of an automated AMD screening system and its performance against clinician grading; the study is single-location and supports screening accuracy, not improved patient outcomes.
